tldr: The Sun in Aquarius: identity built through originality, community, and future vision.
body: With the Sun in Aquarius, the core self strengthens through independent thought, social awareness, and the courage to live outside stale expectations. You are here to bring perspective that serves more than the self.
gift: Innovation, objectivity, humanitarian vision, and the ability to see systems clearly.
challenge: Detachment, contrarianism, and confusing distance with freedom.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
